2026-08-03.title: Bihar Government School Routine Change
bullets: The Bihar government is set to change the Saturday routine in government schools.
A notification regarding the change will be issued soon.
This change is relevant to the BPSC and BSSC exams as it reflects the government's efforts to improve the education system in Bihar.

bullets: The JP Ganga Path will be developed to have a world-class infrastructure.

bullets: The results of the Bihar Civil Services Exam 2025 have been announced.

bullets: The Bihar government has launched a Nasha Mukti Abhiyan to combat drug addiction.

This initiative is relevant to the BPSC and BSSC exams as it highlights the government's efforts to address social issues in Bihar.

2026-08-03.title: RERA Bihar Regulatory Authority

2026-08-03.title: Patna Metro Construction
bullets: The construction of the Patna Metro is underway.

bullets: The Bihar government will develop the JP Ganga Path with a world-class infrastructure.

2026-08-02.title: Bihar State Cooperative Bank to be Modernized
bullets: The Bihar government has decided to modernize the Bihar State Cooperative Bank.
The bank's operations will be made more effective, modern, and people-friendly.

bullets: A MoU has been signed between the Bihar government and Mahashakti Group for an integrated steel project in Gaya.

bullets: The Bihar government has decided to make RERA more transparent, simple, and digital.

This decision is relevant for BPSC and BSSC exams as it falls under the economy and real estate category.

2026-08-02.title: Patna Metro Construction to Ensure Smooth Traffic
bullets: The Bihar government has instructed the authorities to ensure smooth traffic flow during the construction of the Patna Metro.
If necessary, the roads will be widened to prevent traffic congestion.
This project is relevant for BPSC and BSSC exams as it falls under the infrastructure development category.

2026-08-04.title: JP Ganga Path ko milega vishwashtariya swaroop, 65 kilometer Ganga channel hoga viksit
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne JP Ganga path ko vishwashtariya swaroop dena shuru kiya hai, jisme 65 kilometer Ganga channel hoga viksit
Is project ka budget outlay abhi tak nahin diya gaya hai, lekin yeh Bihar ke liye ek bada infrastructure project hoga
Yeh project Bihar sarkar ki Saat Nischay-2 yojana ke tahat aata hai, jiska uddeshya rajya mein vikas ko badhava dena hai

2026-08-04.title: Gayaji mein 6 hazar karod rupey ke ekikrit ispat pariyojana ke liye MoU par hastakshar
bullets: Mukhyamantri ke samaksh Gayaji mein 6 hazar karod rupey ke ekikrit ispat pariyojana ke liye MoU par hastakshar kiya gaya hai
Is pariyojana ka MoU partner Mahashakti group hai, jiske tahat 6 hazar karod rupey ke nivesh ke saath ekikrit ispat pariyojana lagayi jayegi
Yeh pariyojana Bihar sarkar ki Bihar Investment Promotion Policy ke tahat aati hai, jiska uddeshya rajya mein nivesh ko badhava dena hai

2026-08-04.title: Patna Metro nirman ke dauran Nehru path par sugam evam nirbadh yataayat sunishchit karen
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Patna Metro nirman ke dauran Nehru path par sugam evam nirbadh yataayat sunishchit karne ke nirdesh diye hain
Is project ka budget outlay 5000 karod rupey hai, jiske tahat Patna Metro ki nirman kiya jayega
Yeh project Bihar sarkar ki Urban Development Policy ke tahat aata hai, jiska uddeshya rajya ke shaharon mein vikas ko badhava dena hai

2026-08-05.title: Bihar Mein 51600 Karod Rupye Ka Nivesh Hoga
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne desh ke pramukh audyogik samuhon ke saath MoU kiya hai, jiske tahat 51600 karod rupye ka nivesh hoga.
Is nivesh se Bihar mein steel hub, textile aur nuclear energy sector ko bhi badhava milega.
Yeh nivesh Bihar Investment Promotion Policy ke tahat kiya ja raha hai, jiska uddeshya rajya mein audyogik vikas ko badhava dena hai.

2026-08-05.title: Maa Mudeshwari Boddh Gaya SultanGanj Aur Mandar Ke Aitihasik Sthalon Ka Vikas
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Maa Mudeshwari Boddh Gaya SultanGanj aur Mandar ke aitihasik sthalon ka vikas karne ka nirdesh diya hai.
Is vikas yojana ke tahat in sthalon ko vishwa star par parivartit kiya jayega, jisse pariyatan ko badhava milega.
Yeh vikas yojana Bihar Tourism Policy ke tahat kiya ja raha hai, jiska uddeshya rajya mein pariyatan ko badhava dena hai.

2026-08-05.title: JP Ganga Path Ko Milega Vishwa Star Swaroop
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne JP Ganga Path ko vishwa star swaroop dena ka nirdesh diya hai.
Is vikas yojana ke tahat 65 kilometer ganga channel ko viksit kiya jayega, jisse jal parivahan ko badhava milega.
Yeh vikas yojana Bihar Waterways Policy ke tahat kiya ja raha hai, jiska uddeshya rajya mein jal parivahan ko badhava dena hai.

2026-08-05.title: Nasiriganj-Panapur Nishulk Steamer Ferry Seva Ka Shubharambh
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Nasiriganj-Panapur nishulk steamer ferry seva ka shubharambh kiya hai.
Is seva ke tahat logon ko nishulk yatra suvidha pradan ki jayegi, jisse unki aayat-niryaat badhegi.
Yeh seva Bihar Waterways Policy ke tahat kiya ja raha hai, jiska uddeshya rajya mein jal parivahan ko badhava dena hai.

2026-08-05.title: Bihar State Co-Operative Bank Limited Ki Karyapranali Ko Adhik Prabhavi Banane Ka Nirdesh
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Bihar State Co-Operative Bank Limited ki karyapranali ko adhik prabhavi banane ka nirdesh diya hai.
Is nirdesh ke tahat bank ki karyapranali ko adhik prabhavi, aadhunik aur janonmukhi banaya jayega.
Yeh nirdesh Bihar Co-Operative Societies Act ke tahat kiya ja raha hai, jiska uddeshya rajya mein sahakari sansthaon ko majboot banana hai.

2026-08-05.title: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana Evam Gramin Kary Vibhag Ki Lambit Yojanaon Ki Sameeksha
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana evam Gramin Kary Vibhag ki lambit yojanaon ki sameeksha ki hai.
Is sameeksha ke tahat yojanaon ko poora karne ke liye karyavahi ki jayegi, jisse gram sadakon ko badhava milega.
Yeh sameeksha Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana ke tahat kiya ja raha hai, jiska uddeshya desh mein gram sadakon ko badhava dena hai.

2026-08-05.title: RERA Ki Karyapranali Ko Pardarshi, Saral Aur Digital Banane Ka Nirdesh
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne RERA ki karyapranali ko pardarshi, saral aur digital banane ka nirdesh diya hai.
Is nirdesh ke tahat RERA ki karyapranali ko adhik prabhavi, saral aur digital banaya jayega.
Yeh nirdesh RERA Act ke tahat kiya ja raha hai, jiska uddeshya rajya mein avasa yojanaon ko niyantrit karna hai.

2026-08-05.title: Patna Metro Nirman Ke Dauran Nehru Path Par Sugam Evam Nirbadh Yatayat Sunishchit Karen
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Patna Metro nirman ke dauran Nehru path par sugam evam nirbadh yatayat sunishchit karne ka nirdesh diya hai.
Is nirdesh ke tahat metro nirman ke dauran yatayat ko sunishchit kiya jayega, jisse logon ko asani hogi.
Yeh nirdesh Patna Metro Rail Project ke tahat kiya ja raha hai, jiska uddeshya rajya mein metro rail seva ko badhava dena hai.

2026-08-05.title: Gayaji Mein 6 Hazar Karod Rupye Ke Ekikrit Ispat Pariyojana Ke Liye MoU Par Hastakshar
bullets: Mukhyamantri ke samne Gayaji mein 6 hazar karod rupye ke ekikrit ispat pariyojana ke liye MoU par hastakshar kiye gaye hain.
